rationale: P=Choanozoa flagellate (choanoflagellates); M=Metazoa crown keeps motile cilia/flagellated sperm (sponge choanocytes, cnidarians, bilaterians). Module present at P and at M.
source: reviews/round1/evo_biology.md A3 (no loss: Metazoa); King et al. 2008

rationale: F2 adopted (decision D7): path stem Eumycota->Blastocladiomycota_Amastigomycota->Amastigomycota with M=Amastigomycota. Then P (Eumycota) is flagellate (chytrids, Allomyces) and all 26 M species are non-flagellate (Zoopagomycota, Mucoromycota, Dikarya), so loss is expected.
source: Kiss et al. 2019; reviews/round1/evo_biology.md A3 (loss: fungal hyphal node)

rationale: P=Eumycetozoa: its sister Myxogastria_Ceratiomyxa (Physarum, Ceratiomyxa) and outgroups (Variosea, Mastigamoeba) are amoeboflagellates, so the module is present at P. All 6 sampled dictyostelids lack flagella and centrioles, so it is absent at M.
source: reviews/round1/evo_biology.md A3 (loss: Dictyostelia stem, flagellum only); Eichinger et al. 2005

rationale: P=Streptophyta (Mesostigma flagellate). M=Klebsormidiophyceae_Phragmoplastophyta contains Chara, Coleochaete, Marchantia, Physcomitrium, Selaginella and Ceratopteris (flagellate sperm/zoospores), so the module is present at M. The loss is later (Zygnematophyceae reversal; seed plants), not on this stem.
Red algae lack flagella and centrioles throughout. The loss lies on the Rhodophyta stem (Rhodelphis is flagellate), so the module is absent at P=Rhodophytina. Excluded from the concordance count.
P=Ochrophyta (heterokont flagella). M=PX_clade: brown algal gametes/zoospores, Tribonema zoospores and Vaucheria synzoospores are flagellate, so the module is present at M.
P=Chlamydomonas_TGV flagellate. Every volvocine colony cell is biflagellate, so the module is present at M. The same holds under fix F1 (M=Gonium_Volvocaceae).
